scientific_integrity: Original analysis of the exact time optimization and noncommuting high-order/noise limits. Basic bridge covariance, Gaussian regression, and polynomial moments are credited as prior knowledge. Proof is analytic; finite reproducibility checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: One deterministic point, Beta(n,1) polynomial weight, known standard Brownian bridge, independent Gaussian noise of known common variance, and squared-error Bayes estimation; no independent publication-priority verification.
title: Sharp noise-order boundary layer for Beta-weighted Brownian-bridge one-point quadrature
